Hi Olivia —

Thanks — attached is a short proposal tailored for a 3-month pilot (see attached PDF). High-level recap here so procurement can triage quickly: 

- FastPath Pilot (recommended): 99.8% monthly uptime target, 30-min Sev 1 response during business hours, 2-hr Sev 1 response off-hours with automatic on-call escalation. Escalation path includes a named on-call engineer and a weekly sync with our Solutions Engineer.
- Premium Retainer (optional add-on): 15-minute on-call acknowledgement for Sev 1, dedicated escalation lead, and monthly health review. Retainer can be procured for the pilot window at a discounted flat fee.
- Credits & partial-month: credits calculated pro-rata against agreed monthly uptime target; minor incidents (<15 min) are not creditable.
- Pilot discount: 20% off list pricing for the first 3 months if Blue Orbit signs SOW for the pilot within 10 business days.

I've cc'd Marissa to confirm pricing bands and Vanessa for operation/regional escalation coverage. Attached: fastpath-sla-proposal-v1.pdf and a draft SOW (SOW-BlueOrbit-v1.docx).

If that looks good I'll loop in Procurement and get a DocuSign packet ready. We can also set up a 30-min review with our on-call lead tomorrow afternoon.

Regards,

Logan / team —

Confirmed on pricing: FastPath Pilot list price is $18k/month for expected throughput (est. 750k tokens/mo). Pilot 3-month discounted rate at 20% nets $14.4k/mo. Premium Retainer is a flat $6k/mo (list) — pilot add-on at $4.5k/mo if procured with the pilot.

A couple clarifications to include in the PDF/SOW: 
- Uptime crediting: we use monthly SLA windows; credit tiers are 10% of monthly invoice for <99.8%, 25% for <99.0%. Credits do not exceed 50% in any month.
- Off-hours escalation: included in FastPath as fallback (2-hr initial response). Premium Retainer adds 15-minute acknowledgement and direct pager routing.
- Term & termination for pilot: 30-day notice to terminate; no early termination fee for pilot.

Suggest we offer a committed conversion credit: if Blue Orbit converts to a 12-month Dedicated or Hosted contract within 60 days of pilot completion, apply 1 month free (to encourage conversion).
